dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple irregular and scalloped 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral surface. The perimeters show a sharp gradient transition from dark outer boundaries to higher-intensity light interior pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the posterior-lateral flank and cervical region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a sequence of four smaller high-intensity blobs on the mid-lateral flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct elongated high-contrast horizontal streak is visible in the posterior-inferior region, differing in geometry from the surrounding circular-topology patterns.
